description:
Bottom of a letter in Judaeo-Arabic. "It is not hidden from your presence. . . Avraham . .. a dinar. . . since he said qadish in the synagogue. . . and he demands to be. . . " 

Pasted to another sheet of paper and reused for the opening page of an epistle on ophthalmology by ʿĪsā b. ʿAlī and other jottings.
description_he: דף פתיחה של אגרת בנושא רפואת עיניים מאת עיסא ב' עלי.
